title: Ohio's gambling regulator proposes to fine Kalshi $5M for unlicensed sports gambling, after a federal judge ruled that Kalshi's sports bets constitute gambling (Max Filby/The Columbus Dispatch)
summary: Max Filby / The Columbus Dispatch: Ohio's gambling regulator proposes to fine Kalshi $5M for unlicensed sports gambling, after a federal judge ruled that Kalshi's sports bets constitute gambling — The Ohio Casino Control Commission has fined online prediction market Kalshi millions of dollars for illegal operation in the state.
